status.heading: Under review
status.body: A manager at {{academy}} is reading your request. Look around while you wait — these pages fill in the moment you are approved.

profile.heading: Complete your profile
profile.body: Add a photo and check your name. It is the one thing you can finish now, and it is what a manager sees beside your request.

actions.failed: That did not go through. Try again.

my_courses.heading: Your courses
my_courses.title: Your courses appear here
my_courses.body: Once a manager approves you, everything this academy teaches opens from this page.

my_classes.heading: Your class
my_classes.title: Your class appears here
my_classes.body: Your classmates, your teacher and your schedule show up here once you are approved.

records.heading: Answer records
records.title: Your answer records appear here
records.body: Every problem you solve is kept here. Nothing yet — you have not started.

my_points.heading: Your points
my_points.title: Your points appear here
my_points.body: Points you earn are counted here once you join a class.

courses.heading: Courses
courses.title: The curriculum appears here
courses.body: This academy's courses open here once a manager approves you.

classes.heading: Classes
classes.title: Classes appear here
classes.body: The classes you run are listed here once a manager approves you.

ranking.heading: Class ranking
ranking.title: Class standings appear here
ranking.body: Standings are drawn once you have a class with students in it.
